{c_important}Arbiter's Evade{/c} triggers a random equipped {c_important}Core{/c} Skill for every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|1|]{/c} meters traveled. 

{c_important}Core{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased damage during {c_important}Arbiter's Evade{/c} and for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds after.
